name: MAZANOKE
description: Privacy-focused local image optimizer and converter running in your browser as an installable PWA. Compresses JPG, PNG, WebP, and ICO, converts HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, and SVG, targets exact file sizes, resizes dimensions, and strips EXIF metadata with optional HTTP Basic Auth.
short_desc: Privacy-first local browser image optimizer and converter with optional Basic Auth
author: civilblur

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: mazanoke (if left blank, falls back to mazanoke).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: USERNAME
form_fields.hint: Optional HTTP Basic Authentication username (both USERNAME and PASSWORD must be set to enable login). Leave blank to disable authentication.

form_fields.label: PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Optional HTTP Basic Authentication password (both USERNAME and PASSWORD must be set to enable login). Leave blank to disable authentication.
